{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload data to be safe
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Drop QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df.drop(qa_orders.index)

# Confirm removal
print(f'Original rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'After removing QA: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'QA orders removed: {len(qa_orders)}')"}
